items.title: docs: return valid JSON from x402 discovery wrapper (bounty claim)
items.body:
`get_x402_services_sync()` promises a JSON-formatted string, but `str(services)` returns Python representations. A normal nonempty result such as `[{'resource': 'https://example.invalid/research'}]` fails in `json.loads()`; booleans and `None` also use Python spelling.

Import `json` and serialize the service list with `json.dumps()` so callers can parse the documented output and preserve nested values and escaped text.

Validation:

- Executed the exact documented wrapper, isolated via Python AST, with offline fixtures for an empty list, a nested service/payment option, and Unicode/quotes/newlines/boolean/null values. Both nonempty fixtures failed JSON parsing before the fix; all three round-trip correctly afterward.
- Confirmed `limit`, `max_price`, and `offset` reach the async query unchanged, and query failures still propagate.
- Compiled the complete main Python example successfully. No Swarms/model/remote Coinbase integration run is claimed.
- `git diff --check` and MDX compilation with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1 passed.
- The full `mint broken-links` command reports 232 links across 70 files on this Windows host, including two on this page whose local targets exist. All content outside Python fences, including links, is unchanged. A passing site-wide link check is not claimed.

**Bounty claim (bounty-eligible): Bronze, requesting USD 1** under the [documentation bounty program](https://github.com/The-Swarm-Corporation/swarms-framework-docs/blob/main/community/bounty-program.mdx). This is a focused correction to an existing example, within the minor-fix tier. Eligibility and payment remain subject to maintainer confirmation after merge; no prior award is claimed.

Prepared and locally verified with OpenAI Codex assistance.

items.title: docs(readme): add x402 Worker to the local dev block
items.body:
Fixes #13

### Summary

The "Running the whole loop" section started the API and web app but omitted the x402 Worker that serves the paid endpoints (bounty fit, claim stake, PR pre-review). Without it every x402 call fails to connect and the failure looks like an agent bug rather than a missing server.

Add the x402 Worker line after the web-app line so all three servers are grouped before the relay and seed commands.

### Verification

- Visual diff: one line added, nothing else changed
- Comment style matches the surrounding lines (inline comment with server name and port)
- apps/x402 confirmed to have a dev script running on port 4020

items.title: fix: inboundRecorded stays true after Lock/settle
items.body: Soft QA nit after #35 WalletConnect Pay: post-settle snapshot showed `inboundRecorded=false` even with `x402PaymentId` + `fundTxHash` present. **Cause:** `inboundIsRecorded` returned false whenever escrow status was not `pending`. **Fix:** the boolean follows persisted fund hash / x402 payment id, including funded/settled. Fund / Lock UI still gates the unpaid path on `pending_fund` (`inboundRecorded && status === "pending"`). Rebased onto #34 (`dd0444a`) so schema CI is not blocked by the known `suffix` test crash on main. If #34 merges first, this rebase is a no-op. No schema, no new env, no V2. **Click-test:** `GET /api/bounties/` on a paid x402 bounty (e.g. #35) should show `escrow.inboundRecorded: true` and `x402.inboundRecorded: true`.
